$comment: Options for the influxdb storage backend. Keys map 1:1 to InfluxDBBackend.__init__ kwargs (spread by main.create_classes) — keep in lockstep with the constructor; tests/test_config.py enforces this. Every scalar also accepts 'string' and 'null': Config validates this schema BEFORE resolving ${VAR}, and an interpolated value is always a str, or null when a whole-value token resolves empty. 'required' is deliberately absent for the same reason — a '${INFLUXDB_URL}' template would satisfy it and still arrive as null. No 'minimum' either: it would constrain only the integer branch and silently pass '-5'; range checks live in InfluxDBBackend._int_option. All *_ms options are milliseconds, matching influxdb_client.WriteOptions.

tags.$comment: Static tags added to every point. Never derive these from device data — tag cardinality is what kills an InfluxDB instance.

max_retry_time_ms.$comment: Total retry budget for one batch. Defaults to max_close_wait_ms; raising it above that lets the client's non-daemon retry threads outlive shutdown.
